title: The Inhibitory Effects and Cytotoxic Activities of the Stem Extract of Nepenthes miranda against Single-Stranded DNA-Binding Protein and Oral Carcinoma Cells.
authors: Lin, En-Shyh; Huang, Yen-Hua; Chung, Jo-Chi; Su, Hsin-Hui; Huang, Cheng-Yang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究猪笼草茎提取物对单链DNA结合蛋白的抑制及口腔癌细胞毒性，涉及分子对接但非TF-DNA互作，方法简单且对象偏离课题核心。
abstract: The carnivorous pitcher plants of the genus Nepenthes exhibit many ethnobotanical uses, including treatments of stomachache and fever. In this study, we prepared different extracts from the pitcher, stem, and leaf extracts of Nepenthes miranda obtained using 100% methanol and analyzed their inhibitory effects on recombinant single-stranded DNA-binding protein (SSB) from Klebsiella pneumoniae (KpSSB). SSB is essential for DNA replication and cell survival and thus an attractive target for potential antipathogen chemotherapy. Different extracts prepared from Sinningia bullata, a tuberous member of the flowering plant family Gesneriaceae, were also used to investigate anti-KpSSB properties. Among these extracts, the stem extract of N. miranda exhibited the highest anti-KpSSB activity with an IC(50) value of 15.0 +/- 1.8 mug/mL. The cytotoxic effects of the stem extract of N. miranda on the survival and apoptosis of the cancer cell lines Ca9-22 gingival carcinoma, CAL27 oral adenosquamous carcinoma, PC-9 pulmonary adenocarcinoma, B16F10 melanoma, and 4T1 mammary carcinoma cells were also demonstrated and compared. Based on collective data, the cytotoxic activities of the stem extract at a concentration of 20 mug/mL followed the order Ca9-22 > CAL27 > PC9 > 4T1 > B16F10 cells. The stem extract of N. miranda at a concentration of 40 mug/mL completely inhibited Ca9-22 cell migration and proliferation. In addition, incubation with this extract at a concentration of 20 mug/mL boosted the distribution of the G2 phase from 7.9% to 29.2% in the Ca9-22 cells; in other words, the stem extract might suppress Ca9-22 cell proliferation by inducing G2 cell cycle arrest. Through gas chromatography-mass spectrometry, the 16 most abundant compounds in the stem extract of N. miranda were tentatively identified. The 10 most abundant compounds in the stem extract of N. miranda were used for docking analysis, and their docking scores were compared. The binding capacity of these compounds was in the order sitosterol > hexadecanoic acid > oleic acid > plumbagin > 2-ethyl-3-methylnaphtho[2,3-b]thiophene-4,9-dione > methyl alpha-d-galactopyranoside > 3-methoxycatechol > catechol > pyrogallol > hydroxyhydroquinone; thus, sitosterol might exhibit the greatest inhibitory capacity against KpSSB among the selected compounds. Overall, these results may indicate the pharmacological potential of N. miranda for further therapeutic applications.
abstract_zh: 猪笼草属（Nepenthes）的食虫植物具有多种民族植物学用途，包括治疗胃痛和发热。本研究使用100%甲醇制备了Nepenthes miranda的笼、茎和叶提取物，并分析了它们对肺炎克雷伯菌（Klebsiella pneumoniae）重组单链DNA结合蛋白（SSB，KpSSB）的抑制效果。SSB对DNA复制和细胞存活至关重要，因此是潜在抗病原体化疗的一个有吸引力的靶点。同时，还使用了来自苦苣苔科（Gesneriaceae）块茎植物Sinningia bullata的不同提取物来研究其抗KpSSB特性。在这些提取物中，N. miranda的茎提取物表现出最高的抗KpSSB活性，其IC(50)值为15.0 ± 1.8 μg/mL。此外，还展示并比较了N. miranda茎提取物对癌细胞系Ca9-22牙龈癌、CAL27口腔腺鳞癌、PC-9肺腺癌、B16F10黑色素瘤和4T1乳腺癌细胞的存活和凋亡的细胞毒性效应。基于汇总数据，茎提取物在20 μg/mL浓度下的细胞毒性活性顺序为Ca9-22 > CAL27 > PC9 > 4T1 > B16F10细胞。N. miranda茎提取物在40 μg/mL浓度下完全抑制了Ca9-22细胞的迁移和增殖。此外，在20 μg/mL浓度下与该提取物孵育，使Ca9-22细胞中G2期的分布从7.9%增加到29.2%；换言之，茎提取物可能通过诱导G2细胞周期阻滞来抑制Ca9-22细胞增殖。通过气相色谱-质谱联用技术，初步鉴定了N. miranda茎提取物中含量最丰富的16种化合物。使用其中含量最丰富的10种化合物进行对接分析，并比较了它们的对接分数。这些化合物的结合能力顺序为谷甾醇（sitosterol）> 十六烷酸（hexadecanoic acid）> 油酸（oleic acid）> 白花丹素（plumbagin）> 2-乙基-3-甲基萘并[2,3-b]噻吩-4,9-二酮 > 甲基α-D-吡喃半乳糖苷 > 3-甲氧基儿茶酚 > 儿茶酚 > 焦性没食子酸 > 羟基氢醌；因此，在所选择的化合物中，谷甾醇可能对KpSSB表现出最大的抑制能力。总体而言，这些结果可能表明N. miranda在进一步治疗应用中的药理学潜力。
